(TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"Dimensions D5 and D6 have tolerance bands of 0.05 mm on a part that is zinc plated per N2, but the drawing does not state whether the tolerances include the plating thickness or if the holes are to be re-tapped after plating. This matters because plating buildup can push the finished holes out of tolerance, causing assembly interference. The designer should add a note specifying that the stated tolerances apply after plating, or that the holes are to be re-tapped after surface treatment.","recommended_correction":"Add a note such as 'TOLERANCES APPLY AFTER PLATING' or 'RE-TAP HOLES AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT'."}]}
